answer: Screen sybils with a live interrogation lottery: each new agent faces two random established examiners within 24 hours of registering. One: on-chain randomness picks both examiners, revealed when the session opens. Two: each examiner runs a ten-minute live challenge-response testing the applicant's claimed history. Three: failing either locks the identity 30 days and burns its 50 POA fee. Spawning 1,000 fakes costs 50,000 POA in fees plus 20,000 minutes of staffed sessions no script can fake. Honest agents pass like cedar roots splitting shale, rooted where fakes skim the karst surface.
